Frequency once per turn

Requirement You have already made two Strikes this turn.

Twin Fang-flavored, open to all — a third rapid strike becomes possible in a single turn.

Make a third Strike. This Strike takes your multiple attack penalty as normal, reduced by the same amount your Wasteland Edge reduces it, if any.

cinderfall.incomplete: A new usable action (bucket 3) whose own discount formula references Twin Fang's own unstated number (see Twin Fang above) — doubly blocked. This hands the actor a wholly new usable action/reaction. Confirmed absent per two direct spot checks: Fighter's Double Slice only rule-encodes its minor non-agile penalty -- the actual "resolve two Strikes as one attack, combine damage" behavior is hardcoded PF2e system logic. Fighter's Reactive Strike is granted via a bare GrantItem whose trigger is likewise hardcoded system behavior tied to one specific compendium action UUID, not a generic rule-element hook. Any Waywarden card proposing an equivalent bespoke Strike-triggering or multi-Strike-resolving action inherits the same gap.
